Illegal Mining Sewer Tour Keys Update

By: Hein Kaiser | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We report back on the set of keys we found underground

Unique Selling Point:
A curious short follow up on the set of keys that Carte Blanche discovered underground, in Johannesburg's sewers, during the filming of the Zama Zama insert

Summary:
While filming the Zama Zama insert Carte Blanche discovered several items in the sewers underneath Johannesburg, one of these items, a set of keys that was included in the insert. A viewer made contact and shared with us that she was robbed, via smash and grab, at an intersection above ground, and that the keys we found were her parent's house keys. We returned, to look for the keys, but heavy rains must have washed them away.

VO: In a recent investigation we set out to tell the story of a world vastly different from our own.

GERDA: [00:00:32] So someone committed a crime, they'd be down here and within seconds seconds, they disappear. Whether they committed there or somewhere down the line, we will continue to look and see if this might have been a smash and grab, might have been a bag that's been snatched. [00:00:47][15.4]
VO: The two people smiling in the picture on a key ring we stumbled across was, in fact.... them.
VO: Smash and grabs are a common sight at South African intersections. Unwanted spoils are ditched in the drains and sewers. IDs, bank cards and handbags (PAUSE) And as we found out…keys.
VO: After the broadcast, the couple got in touch with the producer and with the assistance of the security team we trailed in our first story, we went back underground. (LONG PAUSE) The new mission: to find the keys
GERDA: [00:01:25] Oh, yeah. Yeah, I was in awe of it. I go through Faulkner section where I got a letter I drive for. [00:01:34][9.4]
VO: But, with the time that has passed, and in the dark confusion of these subterranean passages, it proved mission: impossible
UPS MARIUS: [00:01:48] There's too much water that came down. That's why it's not here. [00:01:48][0.0]
